text.question: What is the late payment fee on the Kova Rewards card?
text.answer: The late payment fee on the Kova Rewards card is up to 30 dollars for the first late payment and up to 41 dollars if another payment is late within the next six billing cycles [kova_rewards_card_terms.pdf, p. 3].
